items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞看好「這家」被徹底拋棄的零售商！或具備「軋空」條件
items.title_en: ‘The Big Short’ Burry Bullish on a Completely Abandoned Retailer – May Have Short‑Squeeze Traits
paras: 美國知名投資人、電影《大賣空》原型人物貝瑞（Michael Burry）再度看好一家看似過氣的零售商，認為毛絨玩具連鎖業者 Build A Bear Workshop (BBW-US) 仍有翻身機會，甚至可能因空頭部位過度集中，引發軋空行情。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Build-A-Bear 經常被視為購物中心盛行時代的過時產物，當時，消費者仍熱衷於前往購物中心逛街。
儘管 Build-A-Bear 股價2026年以來已下跌逾一半，貝瑞仍不改看好態度，認為這家公司有望東山再起。
貝瑞本週在 Substack 發文指出，這家一度被市場判定沒有前景的零售商，仍有「九條命」。
他形容，全球金融危機（GFC）、智慧型裝置普及，以及如今的AI浪潮，都曾被視為可能淘汰這家公司的因素，而當前消費市場走弱、消費者轉向購買較低價商品，也再度為公司帶來考驗。
貝瑞今年8月首度公開看好 Build-A-Bear Workshop，透露已建立該公司多頭部位。他近日更新投資分析時表示，如果這家公司真的有九條命，目前還剩下五條。
Build-A-Bear 股價今年遭受重挫，但過去五年仍取得不錯的成長表現。2023年期間，該股甚至有一段時間的漲幅超越輝達(NVDA-US) 。
不過，該公司今年的股價走勢確實出現重大轉變。儘管如此，貝瑞認為，這檔股票已具備引發軋空行情的有利條件，並將其視為典型的迷因股交易機會。
他表示：「對 Build-A-Bear 而言，這是一場完美風暴。這是一家獨一無二的零售商，目前卻遭到大量放空，流通股中有25%遭放空，空頭回補天數接近9天。」
貝瑞表示：「這屬於典型的非必需消費品，至少表面上看是這樣。這檔股票在新冠疫情引發市場恐慌時曾跌至1.8美元，去年一度飆升至75美元以上，如今卻在25美元附近徘徊。」
Build-A-Bear 的市場形象或許與迷因股類似，但 Burry 的分析也凸顯出，他認為這家公司確實具備實質成長潛力。他肯定公司過去十年來持續調整並重新聚焦銷售策略的努力，並指出從多項指標來看，這項策略已取得成效。
他表示：「如今，Build-A-Bear 在全球37個國家擁有662個據點，其中129個是在過去兩年新增的。公司成長動能愈來愈多來自批發與合作夥伴通路，以及小型店面和交通樞紐據點等營運模式，而這些形式幾乎不需要公司投入任何資本支出。」
值得注意的是，貝瑞過去也曾看好市場上最知名的迷因股之一遊戲驛站(GME-US) ，但他後來已證實退出相關投資部位。
paras_en: US well‑known investor, the real‑life Michael Burry from The Big Short, again bullish on a seemingly obsolete retailer, believing plush‑toy chain Build‑A‑Bear Workshop (BBW‑US) still has a comeback chance, and may trigger a short‑squeeze due to overly concentrated short positions.
According to Business Insider, Build‑A‑Bear is often seen as a relic of the mall‑era, when consumers still loved going to shopping malls.
Although Build‑A‑Bear’s stock has fallen more than half since 2026, Burry remains optimistic, saying the company could rise again.
Burry wrote on Substack this week that the retailer once deemed hopeless still has “nine lives”.

He notes that the Global Financial Crisis, the proliferation of smart devices, and today’s AI wave were all seen as potential killers for the company, and the current weakening consumer market and shift to lower‑priced goods present another test.
Burry first publicly expressed optimism for Build‑A‑Bear in August, revealing he had built a long position. In a recent update he said that if the company truly has nine lives, five remain.
Build‑A‑Bear’s stock has been hammered this year, but over the past five years it has delivered solid growth. During 2023 the share even outperformed Nvidia (NVDA‑US) for a period.
However, the stock’s trajectory this year has changed markedly. Nevertheless, Burry believes the stock now has favorable conditions for a short‑squeeze and views it as a classic meme‑stock trade.
He said: “For Build‑A‑Bear this is a perfect storm. It’s a unique retailer that is currently heavily shorted, with 25% of the float shorted and the short‑covering period close to nine days.”

Burry added: “It’s a typical non‑essential consumer good, at least on the surface. The stock fell to $1.80 during the COVID‑induced market panic, surged past $75 last year, and now trades around $25.”

Build‑A‑Bear’s market image may resemble a meme stock, but Burry’s analysis also highlights genuine growth potential. He praised the company’s decade‑long effort to adjust and refocus its sales strategy and noted that multiple indicators show the strategy is bearing fruit.

He said: “Today Build‑A‑Bear operates 662 locations in 37 countries, with 129 added in the past two years. Growth momentum is increasingly coming from wholesale and partner channels, as well as small‑format stores and transit‑hub locations, which require virtually no capital expenditure from the company.”
It is worth noting that Burry previously was bullish on one of the most famous meme stocks, GameStop (GME‑US), but he has since confirmed he exited that position.

items.title: 費半崩跌7.2%、台積電ADR重挫近6%！台股最慘還沒到→還有更大的崩跌在後？
items.title_en: Semiconductor Index Plummets 7.2%, TSMC ADR Slides Nearly 6% – Taiwan Stocks Still Not the Worst, Is a Bigger Crash Ahead?
paras: 上周五美股大跌！費半指數暴跌7.2％，台積電ADR重挫5.95％，輝達跌4.22%，英特爾更慘暴跌近29%。台股黑色星期一顯然是逃不過了！看著手中股票一檔接一檔下跌，帳面獲利不斷縮水，很難不冒出一個念頭：「是不是還有更大的崩跌在後面？要不要先全部砍掉，等真的落底再買回來？」
這個想法很正常，但往往也是最貴的決定。因為市場最會懲罰的，不是買貴的人，而是在恐慌低點把好公司賣掉的人。所以，江江提醒大家：股價下跌，不代表公司變差！現在最重要的不是跟著市場恐慌殺低，而是分清楚短線恐慌與長線趨勢。
AI泡沫來了嗎？先看企業還有沒有賺錢！
這波科技股重挫與市場對AI投資支出、企業獲利回報及財測的疑慮有關。這個擔憂並非沒有道理。AI基礎建設投入龐大資金，市場當然會追問：花這麼多錢，到底能賺回多少？
但要注意，AI投資報酬率受到質疑，不代表AI需求立即消失，更不代表所有供應鏈企業的獲利都會反轉。就像一家排隊名店，突然因為暴雨而沒人上門，不代表它的招牌菜突然變難吃了。股價反映市場預期，企業能否持續賺錢，才是長線投資的關鍵。
以台灣供應鏈來看，台積電就是最明顯的例子。它第三季合併營收1兆4,942億元，年增50.9%；稅後淨利7,630.6億元，年增68.7%；EPS 29.43元，前三季累計EPS已達78.75元。這不是靠題材撐起來的公司，而是營收、獲利、毛利率都還在高位運轉的核心資產。
所以，當台積電ADR因為美股情緒被殺近6%時，你要問的不是「台積電是不是不行了」，而是「全球最先進晶片的供不應求，有沒有因為這根K棒消失？」答案很明顯：沒有。
融資清洗加劇賣壓，落底訊號值得觀察
市場急跌時，最怕的不只是利空，而是融資槓桿引發的多殺多連鎖賣壓。股價下跌、維持率降低，部分投資人被迫賣股，進一步壓低股價。這就像骨牌一張接一張倒下，短線跌勢可能因此加劇。不過，融資減少有利籌碼的清洗、多頭的反攻！
上周五比較值得注意的訊號，是急跌後可能出現的「低檔雙背離」：指數創低，但RSI、KD等擺盪指標沒有同步破底。這通常代表空方力道正在衰竭，市場的恐慌賣壓不像表面那麼無止盡。
當然，背離不是「明天必漲」的保證書。它比較像天氣預報說暴雨快停了，你不用立刻衝出門，但也不該因為還在下雨，就把雨傘丟掉。接下來更實用的做法，是等「落底四部曲」：
1急跌：利空齊發，把不堅定的融資洗出去。
2盤底：跌完開始震盪，小紅小黑交替，把底部磨出來。
3缺口：出現向上跳空缺口，三天內不被回補，代表利空出盡。
4起攻：KD低檔黃金交叉、MACD柱狀體翻紅，確認反攻開始。
急跌盤底先分批買基本部位，缺口和金叉確認後再加碼。
5檔指標股，看獲利不看情緒 股價打折下來才有甜蜜點
台積電(2330-TW)：全球先進製程與先進封裝核心，第三季EPS 29.43元、獲利年增68.7%，先進製程占晶圓銷售金額79%。AI晶片與2奈米擴產是長線主軸，拉回反而讓估值與籌碼更健康。
聯發科(2454-TW)：從手機SoC跨入AI ASIC，已傳出取得字節跳動客製化晶片訂單；第三季獲利季增逾一成，EPS 17.5元，並宣布配發上半年度現金股利24.5元。短線受市場情緒壓抑，但成長引擎正在切換。
鴻海(2317-TW)：AI伺服器組裝與垂直整合能力是核心，雲端大廠資本支出續強，讓其AI伺服器出貨動能具備支撐。它不是最性感的題材股，卻是AI基建落地時很難繞開的製造要角。
川湖(2059-TW)：AI伺服器高階滑軌龍頭，產品單價與技術門檻高，受惠伺服器機櫃密度、重量與散熱需求提升。這種關鍵零組件的邏輯是：只要AI伺服器持續放量，高階規格需求就會跟著升級。
奇鋐(3017-TW)：水冷與散熱模組供應鏈要角。AI晶片功耗愈來愈高，散熱從「配角」變成「能不能穩定運算」的關鍵；當算力軍備競賽繼續，散熱需求就會跟著膨脹。
結論：投資比的是氣長與心態。現在最忌諱兩種操作：一種是恐慌砍在低點，另一種是看到跌深就一次押滿。市場大跌，本來就是好公司在打折特賣。鎖定實質獲利成長的一線龍頭，靜待「落底四部曲」的攻擊訊號確認，這波拉回，絕對是老天爺送給有準備的上班族最棒的財富重分配禮物！

paras_en: Last Friday U.S. stocks tumbled! The semiconductor index crashed 7.2%, TSMC ADR plunged 5.95%, Nvidia fell 4.22%, and Intel slumped almost 29%. A black‑Monday for Taiwan equities was inevitable. Watching one stock after another slide, paper gains evaporated, it’s hard not to wonder: “Is an even bigger crash coming? Should I cut everything now and wait to buy back at the bottom?”

That thought is natural, but it’s often the most costly decision. The market punishes not the buyers who pay too much, but those who sell good companies at panic‑driven lows. So Jiang Jiang reminds everyone: a falling price doesn’t mean a deteriorating business! The priority now isn’t to join the panic‑sell, but to distinguish short‑term fear from the long‑term trend.
Is the AI bubble here? First check whether companies are still profitable!

The recent tech‑stock rout stems from doubts about AI spending, corporate profit returns and forecasts. The concern isn’t unfounded – AI infrastructure requires massive capital, and the market naturally asks: after spending so much, how much can be earned back?

But questioning AI’s ROI doesn’t mean AI demand vanishes instantly, nor that every supply‑chain player’s earnings will reverse. It’s like a popular restaurant closed by a sudden downpour – the signature dish isn’t suddenly worse. Stock prices reflect market expectations; a company’s ability to keep earning is the real long‑term investment key.

Looking at Taiwan’s supply chain, TSMC is the clearest example. Its Q3 consolidated revenue hit NT$1.4942 trillion, up 50.9% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$763.06 billion, up 68.7%; EPS was NT$29.43, and the first three quarters’ cumulative EPS reached NT$78.75. This isn’t a hype‑driven firm; it’s a core asset with revenue, profit and margin still operating at high levels.

Therefore, when TSMC ADR is knocked down nearly 6% by U.S. market sentiment, the question isn’t “Is TSMC failing?” but “Is the global shortage of cutting‑edge chips erased by this single candle?” The answer is clearly: no.
Financing clean‑up intensifies selling pressure; bottom‑signaling cues merit attention

When markets plunge, the biggest fear isn’t just bad news, but leveraged financing that triggers a cascade of forced sales. Falling prices lower maintenance margins, forcing some investors to liquidate, which pushes prices down further – like dominoes falling one after another, potentially amplifying short‑term declines. Yet a reduction in financing also cleanses weak hands and can set the stage for a bullish counter‑attack!

A noteworthy signal last Friday was a possible “low‑level double divergence” after the sharp drop: the index made new lows, but oscillators such as RSI and KD did not break down in tandem. This often indicates that bearish momentum is waning and that panic selling isn’t endless.

Of course, divergence isn’t a guarantee of a rise tomorrow. It’s more like a weather forecast saying the heavy rain is easing – you don’t sprint out immediately, but you also don’t toss the umbrella just because it’s still drizzling. A more practical approach is to wait for the “four‑step bottoming process”:
1. Rapid drop: a flood of negative news flushes out weak financing.
2. Bottom formation: after the fall, the market oscillates, alternating small reds and greens, grinding out the base.
3. Gap upward: an upward gap appears and isn’t filled within three days, signalling that negative news has been exhausted.
4. Attack phase: KD shows a low‑level golden cross, MACD histogram turns red, confirming the start of a rally.
Buy core positions in batches during the rapid‑drop and bottom phases, then add on after the gap and golden‑cross confirmations.
5. Look for fundamentally strong stocks, not sentiment‑driven ones. Discounts create sweet entry points.

TSMC (2330‑TW): core of global advanced process and packaging, Q3 EPS NT$29.43, profit up 68.7% YoY, advanced processes account for 79% of wafer sales. AI chips and 2‑nm expansion are long‑term drivers; the pull‑back actually makes valuation and capital structure healthier.

MediaTek (2454‑TW): moving from mobile SoC into AI ASIC, rumored to have secured a custom chip order from ByteDance; Q3 profit rose over 10% QoQ, EPS NT$17.5, and announced a H1 cash dividend of NT$24.5. Short‑term sentiment is subdued, but the growth engine is shifting.

Foxconn (2317‑TW): AI server assembly and vertical integration are core strengths; cloud‑provider capex remains strong, supporting AI‑server shipment momentum. It isn’t the flashiest theme stock, but it’s a manufacturing pillar hard to bypass when AI infrastructure rolls out.

Chuan‑hu (2059‑TW): leader in high‑end AI server rails, with high unit price and technical barriers, benefiting from increased rack density, weight and cooling needs. The logic for such critical components is simple: as AI servers scale, demand for high‑spec rails upgrades accordingly.

Chi‑Hong (3017‑TW): key supplier of water‑cooling and thermal modules. AI chips consume ever‑more power, turning cooling from a supporting role into a make‑or‑break factor for stable computation; as the compute arms race continues, cooling demand will expand.

Conclusion: investing is a test of stamina and mindset. Two practices to avoid now: panic‑selling at lows, and loading up all‑in just because the dip is deep. A market crash is essentially a discount sale of good companies. Target front‑line leaders with real profit growth, wait for the “four‑step bottom” signals, and this pull‑back will be the best wealth‑reallocation gift for prepared office workers!

items.title: 美國期中選舉也無法阻止科技股下跌？野村：只有Fed停止升息才有用
items.title_en: Midterm US Election Won't Halt Tech Stock Decline? Nomura Says Only a Fed Pause Can Help
paras: 全球科技股近期持續承壓，市場原本期待美國期中選舉落幕後，政策不確定性消退能為股市帶來反彈契機，但野村證券（Nomura）策略師Naka Matsuzawa認為，市場可能高估選舉結果對金融市場的影響。他認為，真正可能扭轉科技股跌勢的關鍵，在於聯準會（Fed）停止升息。
Matsuzawa指出，科技股當前面臨的壓力，並非主要來自選舉不確定性，而是人工智慧（AI）投資前景轉弱，以及企業信貸風險疑慮持續升高。即使半導體股近期出現反彈，也不足以帶動全球科技板塊全面回升。
Matsuzawa在近日發布的宏觀策略週報中預測，美國11月2日當週期中選舉期間，股市可能走弱、債市偏強，美元承壓、日元走強。
他認為，在聯準會政策真正轉向之前，全球科技股恐怕難以迎來持續性的全面反彈。

期中選舉影響遭高估 科技股反彈恐落空

市場普遍認為，如果民主黨同時拿下參眾兩院，美股可能下跌、債券上漲、美元走弱，原因在於投資人擔心財政政策陷入僵局，以及政府加強AI監管，包括限制資料中心建設等措施。
不過，Matsuzawa對此抱持懷疑態度。他指出，首先，期貨等金融市場中，與期中選舉相關的事件風險溢價已明顯下降；其次，預期可能受到監管收緊衝擊的企業，股價並未明顯落後大盤。
這代表科技股近期走弱，未必直接受到監管政策疑慮影響，選舉本身也可能不是左右市場走勢的主要因素。
Matsuzawa因此認為，期中選舉結束後，市場原本期待的不確定性消退，未必足以推動股市反彈，押注選後行情回升的投資人可能失望。

科技股內部分歧擴大 AI投資疑慮仍未消退

過去一週，科技板塊內部出現明顯分化。自7月以來表現落後的半導體股開始反彈，先前相對抗跌的超大型雲端服務業者（Hyperscalers）及軟體股，反而轉為走弱。
Matsuzawa認為，這不只是資金在科技板塊內部輪動，背後反映出投資人對企業獲利與資本支出策略的態度正在改變。
目前市場呈現兩項特徵：一方面，企業核心業務營收與獲利即使優於預期，也未必能獲得市場明顯肯定，但一旦業績不如預期，股價反應就相當劇烈；另一方面，相較於積極擴大資本支出，投資人更青睞控制投資規模、改善現金流及提高股東回報的企業。
這些現象顯示，市場對AI投資可能大幅放緩的疑慮仍相當深。
儘管美國費城半導體指數（SOX）上週上漲6.9%，但日本與南韓半導體股仍未真正擺脫修正走勢。
此外，通常被視為AI投資復甦領先指標的資本財與機械類股，也沒有明顯改善，反映市場對AI投資前景的信心尚未實質回升。

信貸疑慮與升息預期牽動市場 美日歐利率走勢分歧

債券市場方面，上週出現一項值得注意的現象：企業信貸風險疑慮雖然有所緩解，但美國長天期公債殖利率下滑，日本與德國長天期公債殖利率卻反而走高。
Matsuzawa將這種差異歸因於各國央行政策會議結果，相較於市場原先預期呈現不同的鷹派與鴿派程度。
他指出，聯準會此次政策訊號比市場預期更偏向鴿派，並承認金融情勢已經收緊；歐洲央行同樣承認金融情勢緊縮，但明確釋出12月升息訊號；日本央行則未提及金融情勢收緊，並明確表示基礎通膨已達2%，同時上調通膨預測。
至於上週企業信貸疑慮為何緩解，Matsuzawa提出兩種可能解釋：一是市場對美國升息的預期下降，二是科技企業財報表現及IPO前景改善，讓投資人對企業融資能力更有信心。
不過，由於超大型雲端服務業者上週股價表現疲弱，他較傾向第一種解釋，也就是信貸市場情緒改善，主要受到美國升息預期降溫帶動。
他警告，如果下週美國就業報告表現優於預期，可能重新推升市場對聯準會升息的預期，進而再次引發信貸風險疑慮，讓市場局勢更加複雜。

美元走勢受信貸情緒主導 日元多頭仍有增持空間

匯市方面，上週美元走強、日元承壓，美元兌日元一度下探157.5至158區間。
這項走勢看似與美國升息預期下降的市場邏輯相反，因為升息預期降溫通常會對美元造成壓力。Matsuzawa指出，企業信貸疑慮緩解，帶動半導體股與銀行股反彈，支撐美股相對表現，也吸引先前撤離的資金重新流入美元資產。
他提醒，如果半導體股與銀行股的反彈無法延續，市場將重新聚焦美國升息預期下降的影響，屆時美元可能面臨更大的下行壓力。
日元方面，截至10月20日的投機性外匯部位數據顯示，日元多頭部位已經增加，但目前規模僅相當於2025年4月美國關稅政策衝擊期間高峰的39%，意味著日元多頭仍有相當大的增持空間。

聯準會停止升息 才是科技股反彈關鍵

對於科技股何時能擺脫低迷，Matsuzawa認為，目前很難找到足以扭轉全球科技股走勢的催化因素。無論是期中選舉結果、板塊內部輪動，或個別企業財報，都不足以從根本上改變市場趨勢。
他指出，目前最值得關注、也最有可能帶動市場轉變的因素，是聯準會升息週期正式結束。
在此之前，緊縮金融環境將持續對科技股估值造成壓力，市場對AI投資能否持續的疑慮也難以消除。
Matsuzawa因此維持原有預測，認為在聯準會政策真正轉向之前，全球科技股仍難以出現具有持續性的全面反彈。
paras_en: Global tech stocks have been under pressure recently, and the market originally hoped that the end of the US midterm elections would ease policy uncertainty and provide a rebound catalyst, but Nomura strategist Naka Matsuzawa believes the market may be overestimating the election's impact on financial markets. He says the real key to reversing the tech slump lies in the Federal Reserve stopping rate hikes.

Matsuzawa points out that the pressure on tech stocks today does not mainly stem from election uncertainty, but from a weakening outlook for AI investment and rising concerns over corporate credit risk. Even though semiconductor shares have shown a recent bounce, it is insufficient to lift the global tech sector as a whole.

In a recent macro strategy weekly note, Matsuzawa forecast that during the week of the US November 2 midterm elections, equities could weaken, bonds could strengthen, the dollar could be under pressure, and the yen could rise.
He believes that until the Fed’s policy truly pivots, global tech stocks are unlikely to see a sustained, broad-based rebound.

Midterm election impact is over‑estimated; tech rally may fall flat. The market generally thinks that if Democrats capture both houses, US stocks could fall, bonds rise and the dollar weaken, as investors worry about fiscal gridlock and tighter AI regulation, including limits on data‑center construction.

Matsuzawa is skeptical. He notes that the risk premium for election‑related events in futures and other markets has already dropped sharply, and that stocks of firms expected to feel regulatory pressure have not lagged the broader market noticeably.
This suggests that the recent weakness in tech stocks may not be directly driven by regulatory concerns, and the election itself may not be the primary market driver.
Matsuzawa therefore argues that the disappearance of uncertainty after the election may not be enough to spark a market bounce, and investors betting on a post‑election rally could be disappointed.

Internal divisions within tech are widening; AI investment doubts persist. Over the past week the sector showed clear divergence. Semiconductor stocks, which have lagged since July, began to rebound, while the previously resilient hyperscalers and software names turned weaker.
Matsuzawa says this is not just a rotation of capital within tech, but reflects a shift in investors’ attitudes toward corporate earnings and cap‑ex strategies.

The market now shows two traits: first, even when core revenue and earnings beat expectations, the upside is often muted, yet any miss triggers a sharp price drop; second, investors prefer firms that curb spending, improve cash flow and boost shareholder returns over those that aggressively expand cap‑ex.
These patterns indicate that concerns over a possible sharp slowdown in AI spending remain deep.
Although the US Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) rose 6.9% last week, Japanese and South Korean semiconductor stocks have not truly escaped a corrective trend.

Moreover, capital‑goods and machinery stocks—often seen as leading indicators of an AI investment recovery—have shown no clear improvement, reflecting that confidence in AI prospects has not materially revived.

Credit worries and rate‑hike expectations are moving markets; US, Japan and Europe rate paths diverge. In the bond market, last week saw an interesting development: corporate credit concerns eased, yet US long‑term Treasury yields fell while Japanese and German long‑term yields rose.
Matsuzawa attributes this divergence to the outcomes of central‑bank policy meetings, which turned out more hawkish or dovish than the market had anticipated.

He notes the Fed’s latest signal was more dovish than expected, acknowledging tighter financial conditions; the ECB also recognized tightening but signaled a December rate hike; the BOJ, however, did not mention tightening, stating core inflation has hit 2% and raising its inflation forecast.

Regarding why corporate credit worries eased last week, Matsuzawa offers two possible explanations: a drop in expectations for US rate hikes, and improved earnings and IPO outlooks for tech firms, boosting confidence in their financing ability.
Because hyperscaler stocks were weak last week, he leans toward the first explanation—that improved credit‑market sentiment was mainly driven by cooling US rate‑hike expectations.
He warns that if next week’s US jobs report comes in stronger than expected, it could revive expectations of further Fed tightening, reigniting credit‑risk concerns and complicating market dynamics.

Dollar moves were driven by credit sentiment; yen bulls still have room to add. In the FX market, the dollar strengthened and the yen weakened last week, with USD/JPY briefly dipping into the 157.5‑158 range.

This move seems contrary to the logic that lower US rate‑hike expectations should pressure the dollar, but Matsuzawa says easing credit worries lifted semiconductor and bank stocks, supporting US equities and drawing funds back into dollar assets.
He cautions that if the semiconductor and bank rebounds stall, the market will refocus on the impact of lower US rate‑hike expectations, potentially putting further downward pressure on the dollar.

On the yen side, speculative FX position data as of Oct 20 show yen long positions have risen but are only about 39% of the peak seen during the April 2025 US tariff shock, indicating substantial room for additional yen buying.

Fed pause is the key to a tech rebound. Regarding when tech stocks can emerge from their slump, Matsuzawa says it is hard to find a catalyst strong enough to reverse the global tech trend. Neither the midterm election outcome, sector rotation nor individual earnings are sufficient to fundamentally change market direction.
He highlights that the most important—and most likely—factor that could shift the market is the official end of the Fed’s rate‑hike cycle.
Until then, a tight financial environment will continue to pressure tech valuations, and doubts about the sustainability of AI investment will remain hard to dispel.
Matsuzawa therefore sticks to his original forecast: global tech stocks are unlikely to achieve a sustained, broad‑based rebound until the Fed’s policy truly turns.

items.title: AI投資熱潮還沒結束？亞德尼點名「3大利多」
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮近期遭遇市場質疑，Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 第三季財報表現不如預期，更加深投資人對科技巨頭鉅額資本支出能否帶來相應回報的疑慮。不過，資深市場策略師亞德尼（Ed Yardeni）認為，市場不必過度悲觀，目前仍有三大正面訊號顯示，AI投資熱潮尚未退燒。
根據《Business Insider》報導，隨著AI基礎建設支出持續攀升，投資人開始重新檢視相關投資的經濟效益。
微軟(MSFT-US) 下修全年AI資本支出預測，也讓市場更加擔心AI投資尚未產生預期回報，其他大型雲端服務業者的資本支出規模同樣受到關注。
然而，亞德尼認為，儘管市場疑慮升高，目前AI產業的正面發展仍多於負面因素。
他並提出三項值得投資人關注的指標，分別是科技業融資與支出動能依然強勁、AI商業模式逐漸展現獲利潛力，以及半導體業者財報持續反映強勁需求。
一、支出動能依然強勁
儘管微軟下修今年的資本支出預測，亞德尼仍看到其他科技業龍頭持續投入大量資金。他特別指出，本週浮現的AI相關融資總額達2,350億美元，顯示這個產業很可能繼續成長。
這筆金額包括Anthropic可能透過首次公開募股（IPO）籌集的1,000億美元、Meta(META-US) 預計透過增發股票籌集的950億美元，以及馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US) 計畫借款400億美元，用於採購新款GPU。
二、AI商業模式展現正面訊號
亞德尼對AI產業經濟效益的觀察，主要聚焦於Anthropic。他認為，這家AI實驗室的成功有幾項指標值得投資人注意，顯示AI運算需求不僅強勁，也具有持續性。
他列出四項值得關注的數據：

今年上半年營收年增，從12億美元躍升至163億美元。
營業虧損從21億美元降至6.93億美元，第二季更首度實現單季營業獲利。
每年支出至少10萬美元的客戶已達1.19萬家，遠高於一年前的約950家。
每投入1美元運算成本所創造的營收增加逾5倍，達2.08美元。


三、晶片業者財報表現強勁
亞德尼也表示，他相信AI基礎設施需求將持續強勁，南韓記憶體大廠SK海力士(000660KS) 第三季財報表現亮眼，就是一項佐證。
談到這家南韓半導體業者時，他指出：「管理層預期，記憶體短缺將持續至2030年，產能實際上已經售罄至2029年，顯示需求具有持續性，業者也具備價格主導能力。」
他表示：「這些發展進一步強化我們的看法，也就是AI投資熱潮將持續下去。」

items.title: AI行情還能漲？高盛兩策略師看法分歧：獲利已見頂 VS. 投資報酬率明確
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮正面臨新的市場考驗。美國科技巨頭近期財報表現不一，儘管雲端業務仍維持高速成長，龐大的資本支出與現金流壓力卻引發投資人疑慮，也讓市場開始重新評估AI投資究竟能為企業帶來多少實際報酬。高盛兩位資深策略師本週接連發布報告，卻對後市提出截然不同的看法。
高盛策略師Tony Pasquariello認為，標普500指數企業獲利成長可能已經見頂，市場上行動能將逐漸減弱，目前不適合大舉押注。
不過，高盛倫敦策略師Mark Wilson則認為，超大規模雲端業者（Hyperscalers）的最新財報，已相當清楚地證明AI投資回報正在顯現，因而維持看多立場。
兩種觀點的分歧，也反映出當前市場最核心的爭議：AI需求雖然強勁，但企業能否將龐大的訂單轉化為自由現金流與實際獲利，仍有待驗證。

科技股劇烈震盪 市場內部出現明顯分化

美股科技股上週經歷劇烈震盪，Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 創下上市以來最大單日跌幅，英特爾(INTC-US) 也出現史上最嚴重單日跌勢，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 財報同樣未能滿足市場期待，帶動那斯達克100指數一度跌入技術性修正區間。
然而，標普500指數10月僅下跌0.93%，表面上看來市場並未出現太大波動，但若排除AI相關股票，標普500其餘成分股反而繳出2022年以來最佳單月表現，顯示資金正在不同類股之間重新配置。
Pasquariello指出，過去4個月標普500指數的累計絕對波動約4個百分點，但高盛旗下旗艦動能因子投資組合GSPRHIMO的累計絕對波動卻高達約90個百分點。
高盛分析師Bobby Molavi先前已將這種市場環境形容為「無從操作」，認為在此期間維持較高持倉的投資人都承受了實質損失。
Pasquariello認為，儘管主要多頭趨勢尚未遭到破壞，但市場上行動能可能減弱，指數表面平靜之下仍將持續劇烈震盪。他目前不打算進行大額押注，態度較一週前已明顯轉趨保守。

Pasquariello：企業獲利成長可能已經見頂

Pasquariello對AI行情的疑慮，主要來自科技巨頭最新一輪財報。
他認為，即使部分雲端業務仍能在龐大營收基礎上維持高速成長，第三季財報季整體而言仍令人失望。原因在於，超大規模雲端業者持續提高資本支出的同時，部分公司的核心業務表現卻未能跟上預期。
他指出，標普500企業獲利整體表現確實出色，但獲利成長已愈來愈明顯地接近高峰。此外，相較前幾個財報季度，市場對企業未來每股盈餘（EPS）的預估上修幅度也已顯著放緩。
換言之，市場開始反映的不只是企業目前的獲利水準，更包括獲利成長速度可能正在減弱。
在這種環境下，非AI類股反而成為近期資金流向的受益者。剔除AI股票的標普500指數在科技巨頭股價下跌期間持續創高。
展望年底行情，Pasquariello仍提出三項可能支撐股市的因素：市場情緒已明顯轉向悲觀、季節性行情正從年內相對疲弱的8月中旬至10月中旬，轉向歷史上相對強勢的10月中旬至年底，以及市場已花費一個月時間消化大量多頭部位。
不過，他也坦言，空方同樣可以引用2018年底的市場走勢作為警示。

Wilson看好AI投資回報 兩大雲端業者訂單達1.1兆美元

相較之下，Wilson對AI產業前景仍抱持樂觀態度。他在最新報告指出，市場可能忽略了雲端業者財報所揭露的強勁需求。
他列舉，Google Cloud營收年增103%，積壓訂單年增256%，達5,610億美元；亞馬遜AWS營收年增39%，積壓訂單則年增189%，達5,780億美元。
AWS管理層更明確表示，對2027年及2028年營收成長率超過40%具有信心。微軟(MSFT-US) Azure營收成長率則達48%，雖然受到供應限制，但公司預期下季成長速度將進一步加快。
兩家雲端業者的積壓訂單合計約達1.1兆美元。
Wilson認為，這些成長數據並非來自規模有限的新創公司，而是全球最大型企業所展現的實際業務動能。即使市場本週對科技股利空反應劇烈，雲端業者的營收與訂單表現，已相當明確地回應外界對AI投資報酬率的質疑。
在融資方面，Wilson也認為市場過度擔憂AI資本支出的資金來源。他指出，Meta(META-US) 已完成規模創紀錄的三階段股權融資中的前兩階段，甲骨文(ORCL-US) 則提前調整現金流損益兩平時程，並表示只需額外200億美元，就能支應既定資本支出計畫。
因此，他認為AI資本支出的融資缺口，遠比市場先前擔心的程度小。

訂單規模不代表現金流 市場開始追問誰能真正獲利

不過，龐大的雲端訂單並未完全消除市場疑慮。投資人目前關注的焦點，已從AI需求是否存在，轉向企業能否將需求轉化為現金流，以及龐大資本支出究竟能帶來多少實際回報。
Alphabet就是一個值得關注的案例。儘管公司擁有5,610億美元積壓訂單，本季自由現金流卻流出9.1億美元，與市場原先預期的淨流入35億美元形成落差。
此外，Alphabet 2026年以來尚未進行股票回購，與2025年前三季回購398億美元的情況形成鮮明對比。另一方面，公司同期透過市場發行機制（ATM）發行124億美元新股，並發行287億美元債券。
高盛分析師目前預估，Alphabet 2027年資本支出將達約3,500億美元，2027年每股盈餘甚至可能低於2026年。
超大規模雲端業者的表外財務義務也受到關注。相關追蹤數據顯示，這些企業的表外義務在90天內增加約1兆美元，規模與兩家主要雲端業者的積壓訂單總額大致相當。甲骨文先前改善現金流展望所帶來的利多，也在市場進一步檢視財報後迅速消退。
高盛策略師Rich Privorotsky上週五（30日）將這場爭論歸納為「價值捕獲」（Value Capture）問題。
他認為，AI需求強勁已不是市場最大的疑問，真正的關鍵在於產業鏈中哪些企業能夠取得實際獲利，以及必須付出多少資本成本。
這也是單靠積壓訂單規模，仍無法完整回答的問題。

科技股相關性跌破歷史紀錄 聯準會可能成為下一個變數

儘管兩位策略師對AI行情看法不同，卻都認同當前市場出現了極不尋常的價格走勢。
蘋果(AAPL-US) 股價與那斯達克100指數的三個月實際相關性，首度降至1981年有紀錄以來的負值；標普500指數與等權重標普500指數的相關性則降至約0.62，不僅接近2024年低點，也是2006年以來最低水準。
10月29日的市場表現同樣罕見。當天約80%的標普500成分股收漲，但指數最終仍下跌30個基點，反映大型權值股的疲弱已足以抵銷多數股票的漲勢。
產業表現也出現明顯分歧。本週剔除AI股票的標普500指數較那斯達克指數領先逾3個百分點，法國CAC指數更較美國科技股領先5個百分點。
Wilson援引聯準會過去升息週期中的市場經驗，認為目前的震盪更像是市場短期消化不良，並不代表長期趨勢已經反轉。他進一步提出一個問題：當前AI行情究竟更接近1997年，還是1999年？
不過，1999年的科技產業同樣曾展現亮眼營收成長，真正的差異在於，當時缺乏的是聯準會啟動升息後持續供應的廉價資金。
聯準會本週決議維持利率不變，但出現兩票鷹派異議。達拉斯聯準銀行總裁Lorie Logan表示，至少還需要再升息兩次；聖路易聯邦準備銀行總裁Alberto Musalem也認為，聯準會很快就可能需要升息。
Pasquariello指出，本週聯準會會議幾乎沒有出現在股票交易員的討論焦點中，但這種情況未必會持續太久。

items.title: 美國期中選舉牽動美股！花旗點名「兩大風險」：民主黨若拿下53席恐衝擊股市
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections Grip Wall Street: Citi Flags Two Major Risks—If Democrats Win 53 Senate Seats They Could Hit the Market
paras: 美國期中選舉進入最後倒數，國會參議院控制權成為牽動美股後市的重要變數。花旗（Citi）認為，市場已大致消化民主黨橫掃參眾兩院的預期，真正值得留意的反而是兩種可能超出市場預期的結果：共和黨意外保住參議院，或民主黨取得53席以上、形成大幅勝利。
花旗研究（Citi Research）近日發布美股策略報告指出，民主黨同時掌控參眾兩院的機率近期持續攀升，目前已成為市場最主要的預期情境，但這項結果尚未完全確定，部分關鍵參議院選區的民調差距仍在誤差範圍內，共和黨仍有機會守住多數席次。
花旗策略師認為，若共和黨意外保住參議院，可能為美股年底行情帶來額外推力；反之，若民主黨取得53席以上，投資人將開始提前反映2028年大選後企業稅率可能調升的風險，進而對股票估值造成壓力。
這兩種選舉結果可能引發截然不同的市場反應，金融、醫療等產業的相對表現，以及AI資料中心建設、2027年預算與債務上限談判，都可能成為市場重新定價的焦點。

參院選情仍膠著 民主黨領先優勢尚未穩固

民主黨翻轉參議院的機率過去幾個月持續上升，近期隨著提前投票數據陸續公布，預測市場也進一步向民主黨傾斜。
不過，花旗提醒，參議院選舉結果仍存在相當大的不確定性。
若不計入搖擺州，民主黨目前預計可取得53席，共和黨則為47席。但根據RealClearPolitics的分類，多達16個參議院席次競爭激烈，其中9席更屬於真正的搖擺選區。
預測市場Kalshi最新數據顯示，德州、密西根州及俄亥俄州的民主黨候選人目前分別領先72%、74%及70%；但愛荷華州、內布拉斯加州等地，共和黨候選人仍以些微優勢領先。
花旗指出，若多個搖擺州的民調同時出現系統性偏差，最終結果可能朝同一方向大幅傾斜，使參議院席次分布從共和黨守住多數，到民主黨取得超乎預期的優勢，出現相當大的變化。
美國總統川普的支持率也是觀察選情的重要指標。花旗數據顯示，川普目前的淨支持率約為負21.7%，是近20年來執政黨候選人在期中選舉前面臨的最低支持率之一。
目前民主黨在國會通用選票民調中領先約8.1個百分點，與2018年民主黨領先7.3個百分點的情況相近。
花旗認為，當前政治環境最接近2006年小布希執政時期的期中選舉，當年民主黨在眾議院增加31席、參議院增加6席，成功翻轉兩院控制權。

眾議院翻轉已成市場共識 參議院席次才是關鍵

相較於參議院選情仍充滿變數，花旗基本認定民主黨將拿下眾議院，且市場已大致反映這項結果。
目前共和黨在眾議院僅握有微弱多數，而執政黨在期中選舉失去眾議院席次，本來就是美國政治的常見現象。因此，花旗認為，眾議院控制權易手本身對市場的額外衝擊有限，真正值得關注的是民主黨最終能取得多少席次。
若民主黨僅以些微優勢取得多數，黨內議員在重要法案表決時，將更需要遵循黨團立場；若民主黨大幅擴大席次優勢，部分議員則有更大空間依照選區利益，在關鍵政策議題上採取不同立場，也可能提高民主黨在2028年大選中保住這些席次的機率。
換言之，民主黨在眾議院的勝選幅度愈大，未來實現全面執政的可能性也可能隨之提高。
參議院的影響則更為深遠。由於參議員任期為6年，本屆期中選舉的席次分布，將直接影響2028年參議院的控制權。
花旗指出，民主黨在2028年需要改選的參議院席次，多數位於相對安全的選區。因此，如果民主黨本屆能取得53席以上，將大幅提高2028年繼續掌握參議院的機率，也讓民主黨全面執政的可能性進一步升高。

共和黨意外保住參院 美股年底有望迎來反彈

針對不同選舉結果，花旗提出兩種可能的市場走勢。
第一種情境是共和黨意外守住參議院。由於市場目前已對民主黨橫掃兩院抱有較高預期，共和黨若成功保住參議院，反而可能形成正面意外，為美股年底行情帶來提振。
產業方面，花旗先前提出的「做多醫療、做空金融」相對價值交易策略，目前已大致反映在市場表現中。若共和黨在參議院取得優勢，金融類股可能成為新的市場焦點。
這是因為參議院各委員會的主導權，將影響金融監管政策的走向，而參議院也掌握聯準會理事提名人選的確認權。隨著聯準會（Fed）理事鮑爾（Jerome Powell）任期屆滿，繼任人選的任命也將受到參議院權力分布影響。
第二種情境則是民主黨取得53席以上。花旗預期，這將對美股帶來額外壓力，影響不只反映在短期市場情緒，也可能延伸至中長期估值。
短期而言，民主黨大幅勝選可能令市場情緒承壓；中長期來看，投資人則會開始提前評估2028年大選後企業稅率調升的可能性，這也與民主黨在2024年大選期間提出的政策主張高度一致。
此外，2027年預算與債務上限談判也可能重新成為焦點。民主黨可能推動恢復醫療支出，共和黨則傾向增加國防預算，兩黨政策優先順序不同，可能進一步增加財政赤字壓力。
不過，財政支出增加所帶來的刺激效果，也可能在一定程度上抵銷相關負面影響。

民主黨州長勝選恐拖慢AI資料中心建設

除了國會席次，花旗也提醒，州長及地方選舉結果可能間接影響AI資料中心的建設進度。
預測市場顯示，民主黨候選人可能在威斯康辛州、俄亥俄州、密西根州及內華達州等地的州長選舉取得進展。
花旗指出，民主黨籍州長通常對資料中心建設許可及土地分區規劃採取較審慎的立場，可能使相關專案面臨更多行政程序與審核障礙。
其中，德州的選情尤其值得關注。共和黨籍州長Greg Abbott目前仍在民調中保持一定領先，但共和黨聯邦參議員候選人Ken Paxton支持率下滑，增加選民分票的可能性，使德州參議員選戰也進入競爭狀態。
花旗認為，若德州最終轉向民主黨，將成為觀察美國AI基礎建設投資環境變化的重要指標。
不過，花旗也強調，相關影響主要在於延長資料中心的建設時程，而非直接導致既有計畫取消，因此對產業長期基本面的衝擊相對有限。此外，民主黨政府對基礎建設融資壓力的考量，也可能在資金面帶來部分正面抵銷效果。
花旗：選舉主要影響市場情緒 2028年政策風險成焦點
花旗總結，中期選舉結果不太可能立即改變美股基本面，市場更直接受到選舉結果帶來的投資情緒與政策預期變化影響。
若共和黨意外保住參議院，可能觸發美股階段性反彈，這項情境目前仍不能排除；若民主黨橫掃兩院，短期則可能對股市形成額外壓力，實際衝擊程度也將與德州選情密切相關。
花旗進一步指出，若民主黨最終取得眾議院235席以上、參議院53席以上，市場將更認真評估2028年企業稅率調升，以及民主黨全面掌控國會與白宮的可能性。屆時，相關政策風險可能成為影響美股估值的重要變數。
paras_en: U.S. midterm elections are in the final countdown, and control of the Senate has become a key factor influencing the future direction of U.S. equities. Citi believes the market has largely priced in expectations of a Democratic sweep of both chambers, and the real points to watch are two outcomes that could exceed market expectations: an unexpected Republican hold on the Senate, or Democrats winning more than 53 seats for a decisive victory.

Citi Research recently released a U.S. equity strategy note stating that the probability of Democrats controlling both the House and Senate has been rising and is now the market's primary scenario, but the outcome is still uncertain. Poll margins in several pivotal Senate races remain within the margin of error, leaving the GOP a chance to retain a majority.

Citi strategists say that an unexpected Republican hold on the Senate could add extra upside to the equity market toward year‑end, while a Democratic win of more than 53 seats would prompt investors to start pricing in the risk of higher corporate tax rates after the 2028 election, putting pressure on stock valuations.

These two possible election outcomes could trigger very different market reactions, with relative performance in sectors such as finance and health care, AI data‑center construction, the 2027 budget and debt‑ceiling negotiations all becoming focal points for re‑pricing.

The Senate race remains tight and the Democratic lead is not yet solidified. The odds of Democrats flipping the Senate have risen over the past few months, and as early‑voting data rolls in, market forecasts are shifting further toward the Democrats.
However, Citi cautions that the Senate outcome still carries considerable uncertainty.

Excluding swing states, Democrats are projected to win 53 seats and Republicans 47. But according to RealClearPolitics, as many as 16 Senate seats are highly competitive, with nine of them truly swing districts.

Kalshi’s latest market forecast shows Democratic candidates leading in Texas, Michigan and Ohio with 72%, 74% and 70% respectively, while Republicans retain slight leads in Iowa, Nebraska and other states.

Citi notes that if multiple swing‑state polls exhibit systematic bias, the final result could swing dramatically in one direction, shifting the Senate composition from a Republican majority to an unexpectedly strong Democratic advantage.

President Trump’s approval rating is also a key gauge of the race. Citi data shows Trump’s net approval is about –21.7%, one of the lowest for an incumbent party’s candidate ahead of a midterm in the past two decades.
Democrats currently lead the generic congressional ballot by roughly 8.1 percentage points, similar to the 7.3‑point lead they held in 2018.

Citi believes the current political environment most closely resembles the 2006 midterms under George W. Bush, when Democrats added 31 House seats and six Senate seats, flipping control of both chambers.

House control has become market consensus; Senate composition remains the key driver. Compared with the still‑uncertain Senate outlook, Citi essentially assumes Democrats will win the House and the market has largely reflected that outcome.

Republicans now hold only a thin majority in the House, and it is common for the governing party to lose House seats in a midterm. Therefore, Citi sees limited additional market impact from a House flip and focuses on how many seats Democrats ultimately secure.

If Democrats win a slim House majority, their members will need to stick closely to party positions on key votes; a larger Democratic majority would give some members more leeway to follow district interests on critical policy issues, potentially boosting the party’s chances of retaining those seats in the 2028 election.
In other words, the larger the Democratic win in the House, the higher the likelihood of full‑government control in the future.
The Senate impact is deeper. Because senators serve six‑year terms, this midterm’s seat distribution will directly affect Senate control in 2028.

Citi points out that most of the Senate seats up for election in 2028 are in relatively safe districts for Democrats. Thus, if Democrats capture more than 53 seats this cycle, their odds of holding the Senate in 2028 rise sharply, further increasing the chance of overall Democratic governance.
Republican surprise hold of the Senate could spark a year‑end rally in U.S. equities. Citi outlines two possible market paths based on election outcomes.
Scenario one: Republicans unexpectedly retain the Senate. With the market already pricing in a Democratic sweep, a GOP hold would be a positive surprise and could boost equities toward year‑end.

Sector‑wise, Citi’s earlier “long health‑care, short financials” relative‑value trade is already reflected in market performance. If Republicans gain Senate advantage, financial stocks could become the new market focus.

That’s because Senate committee leadership influences financial‑regulation policy, and the Senate also confirms Federal Reserve board nominees. With Fed Chair Jerome Powell’s term ending, the Senate’s composition will affect his successor’s appointment.
Scenario two: Democrats win more than 53 Senate seats. Citi expects this to add pressure on equities, affecting not only short‑term sentiment but also medium‑ to long‑term valuations.

In the short run, a decisive Democratic victory could weigh on market sentiment; over the medium to long term, investors would begin to price in the possibility of higher corporate tax rates after the 2028 election, a stance that aligns with Democratic policy proposals during the 2024 campaign.

Additionally, the 2027 budget and debt‑ceiling negotiations could re‑emerge as focal points. Democrats may push to restore health‑care spending, while Republicans are likely to favor higher defense budgets, potentially widening fiscal‑deficit pressures.
However, the stimulus effect of increased fiscal spending could partially offset some of the negative impacts.

Democratic gubernatorial wins could slow AI data‑center construction. Beyond congressional seats, Citi warns that governor and local election outcomes may indirectly affect the pace of AI data‑center builds.
Market forecasts suggest Democratic candidates could make gains in gubernatorial races in Wisconsin, Ohio, Michigan and Nevada.
Citi notes that Democratic governors tend to take a more cautious approach to data‑center permits and land‑use zoning, potentially adding administrative hurdles and review delays to projects.

Texas is especially noteworthy. Republican Governor Greg Abbott still leads in polls, but the Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton’s declining support could split the vote, turning the Texas Senate race into a competitive contest.
Citi believes that if Texas ultimately flips Democratic, it would serve as a key indicator of shifts in the U.S. AI infrastructure investment environment.

Citi stresses that the impact would mainly lengthen data‑center construction timelines rather than cancel existing projects, so the long‑term industry fundamentals remain relatively intact. Moreover, Democratic considerations of financing pressure for infrastructure could provide some positive offset on the funding side.
Citi: Elections Mainly Influence Market Sentiment, 2028 Policy Risk Becomes Central

Citi concludes that midterm results are unlikely to immediately alter U.S. equity fundamentals; the market is more directly affected by the sentiment and policy‑expectation changes that elections generate.

If Republicans unexpectedly keep the Senate, a staged equity rebound could occur—this scenario cannot be ruled out. If Democrats sweep both chambers, short‑term pressure on stocks is possible, with the magnitude of impact closely tied to the Texas race.

Citi further notes that if Democrats ultimately secure more than 235 House seats and more than 53 Senate seats, the market will more seriously evaluate the risk of higher corporate taxes in 2028 and the possibility of a fully Democratic Congress and White House. At that point, policy risk could become a major driver of U.S. equity valuations.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre‑Market News: Hon Hai AI Server Rack Capacity Doubles, MediaTek ASIC Q4 Revenue Revised Up to $2.5 Billion
paras:
台股盤前要聞 

1.鴻海(2317-TW)30日舉行2026年鴻海科技日，董事長劉揚偉於開幕致詞時表示，今年邁入第七屆，也是歷年規模最大的一次，特別要向外界展示鴻海的「加乘力」及「垂直整合力」。他也透露，短短一年內，鴻海AI伺服器機架週產能已從上次科技日的1,000架翻倍至每週2,000架，展現快速擴大AI伺服器製造規模的能力。
2.IC設計大廠聯發科(2454-TW)執行長蔡力行30日於法說會表示，首款AI加速器ASIC已於9月開始出貨初期訂單，受惠客戶需求強勁，預估第四季雲端ASIC營收可達25億美元；展望2027年，該專案營收可望達原訂目標區間高標、約160億美元，約占整體AI加速器ASIC市場20%。

3.光寶科 (2301-TW)30日召開法說會，總經理邱森彬表示，800V HVDC Power Rack 已完成第一次送樣，11 月將第二次送樣，預計明年第一季開始出貨。為支應 AI 電源與機櫃級產品的成長，今年資本支出已從 180 億元上修到 197 億元；加上越南廣寧新廠的產線投資、美國德州廠營運，以及在全球擴大研發據點，明年資本支出還會再高於今年。公司預估明年 AI 營收占比可從今年的逾三成提高到四至五成。
4.廣達(2382-TW)30日宣布成立新公司「達穎智能(DaVinCare,DVC)」，技術長張嘉淵表示，成立達穎智能的最主要目標即是「實現AI醫療落地、邁向市場」，將持續深化AI技術在醫療照護領域的應用，打造智慧健康生態系。
5.微控制器廠新唐(4919-TW)30日召開線上法人說明會，展望營運，公司看好遠端伺服器管理晶片(BMC)需求持續成長，將有新的雲端服務供應商(CSP)及新創客戶加入量產行列，帶動客戶數與出貨量增加，業績年成長幅度有機會優於今年。

paras_en: Hon Hai (2317‑TW) held its 2026 Hon Hai Technology Day on the 30th. Chairman Liu Yang‑wei said the event, now in its seventh edition and the largest ever, is meant to showcase the group’s “multiplicative power” and “vertical integration”. He also revealed that within a year the weekly production capacity of Hon Hai’s AI server racks has doubled from the 1,000 units announced at the last Technology Day to 2,000 units, demonstrating rapid scaling of AI server manufacturing.

MediaTek (2454‑TW) CEO Cai Lixing told analysts on the 30th that the first AI‑accelerator ASIC began shipping initial orders in September. Benefiting from strong customer demand, the company now expects Q4 cloud ASIC revenue to reach $2.5 billion. Looking ahead to 2027, the project’s revenue could hit the high end of its original target range, about $16 billion, roughly 20% of the overall AI‑accelerator ASIC market.

Lite‑On (2301‑TW) held an analyst briefing on the 30th. General Manager Qiu Sen‑bin said the 800 V HVDC Power Rack has completed its first sample delivery, with a second sample scheduled for November and mass shipments expected in Q1 2025. To support growth in AI power‑supply and rack‑level products, this year’s capital expenditure was raised from NT$18 billion to NT$19.7 billion. Additional investments in a new plant in Guangning, Vietnam, operations at a Texas facility, and expanded global R&D sites mean next year’s capex will exceed this year’s level. The company forecasts AI‑related revenue to rise from over 30% of total sales this year to 40‑50% next year.

Quanta (2382‑TW) announced on the 30th the creation of a new company, DaVinCare (DVC). CTO Zhang Jiayuan said the primary goal of DaVinCare is to “realize AI‑driven medical applications and bring them to market,” and the firm will continue deepening AI technology use in healthcare to build a smart health ecosystem.

New Tang (4919‑TW) held an online analyst briefing on the 30th. Looking ahead, the company is optimistic about continued growth in demand for remote‑server management chips (BMC). New cloud service providers and startup customers are expected to join mass production, increasing both the number of customers and shipment volumes, giving the company a chance to post year‑over‑year growth that outpaces this year’s performance.

items.title: 〈走進中國〉無人自助KTV 開遍中國縣城
items.title_en: Unmanned Self-Service KTV Spreads Across Chinese County Towns
paras: 大家越來越捂緊錢包、不愛出去玩的時代，依然有線下娛樂生意加速狂奔。
中國女大學生丸子在社交媒體上分享了一段親身經歷。國慶假期期間，她和朋友一起走進縣城老家一家剛開業的無人自助KTV。
正值晚間黃金檔，當地幾乎所有KTV同等規模包間都溢價至人民幣500元以上，而這家無人自助KTV的大包廂定價大約50元一小時，平價得令人感動。顧客可在門口自動販賣機自助購買單價5～10元一瓶的啤酒，也可以選擇自帶酒水和食物。
這天她們原定晚上12點結束，本想續訂兩個小時，結果發現包廂後半夜已經被訂滿。走出包間，KTV狹窄進門處大排長龍，甚至有排隊等候者支了張方凳蹲在門口打起了撲克。
她評價，這家自助KTV生意之火爆有些意料之外，但又在情理之中。畢竟，無人自助娛樂的上一個形態——自助棋牌當初的火爆程度不亞於此，剛出現是常常一房難求，如今不過三年就攻佔了大街小巷。
絡繹不絕的來客背後，這門無人自助生意不斷改頭換面，在消費市場裡逆流而上。
中國財經作家吳曉波說，在線下消費清淡的光景裡，無人自助生意殺出重圍的速度遠超人們想像。
2022年起步的自助棋牌室品牌「四個朋友」，到今年3月底，已經在全中國開出超過1.4萬家棋牌室，迅速成為中國23個邁進「萬店俱樂部」的品牌之一。2025年初又衍生出無人自助KTV品牌「四方朋友」，成立18個月就簽了1,200家門市。
這只是其中之一，市場上還有雀發潮、巨嗨、麥帆等上百個無人自助連鎖品牌和一大批獨立經營門市。有行業數據估算，中國有超過50萬家自助棋牌室、幾千家無人自助KTV，還有上千家無人自助桌球廳、健身房等。
最先被捧出的無人棋牌室，過去3年幾乎已經徹底改變了中國棋牌產業生態。一個70平米的店鋪，隔出七八個5平米左右的小包間，客人在團購平台下單，再跳轉到小程式預約，幾點鐘還剩哪個包廂一目了然。棋牌室老闆則只需在收到散場通知時讓清潔人員過去打掃房間，無人經營的閒置店鋪輕鬆成了「睡後收入」。
三年後自助KTV又成為新風口，在三、四線城市和縣城創業者的圈子裡，幾乎沒有人會對此感到陌生，江西某縣城一位創業者甚至頗為篤定地說，這是去年最炙手可熱的加盟項目之一。
在長沙做了多年無人自助生意的陳先生觀察，這些無人自助KTV的創業者，大部分從自助棋牌室或傳統KTV行業而來。
他對這場熱潮感受頗深。他此前經營傳統茶樓，2021年就把自家茶樓改成了自助棋牌室。2024年底，他加盟了一家雀發潮自助KTV行業，第一家店很快落地大學密集的長沙岳麓區。
這種低價唱歌、酒水可自帶的新鮮模式很快吸引了一批顧客，他作為最早入局者也順利吃上螃蟹，不到一年就收回本金，還趁熱打鐵開出了第二家、第三家店。
在他看來，這些自助經營的休閒娛樂場所，與傳統模式有幾個明顯優勢。
首先就是省錢。無人自助店不用裝修大廳和門頭，也無需配置前台和大量服務員。自助模式還能把營業時間拉長到24小時，天然適合打牌、唱K這種夜間生意。
拿KTV來說，相比動輒投入人民幣一兩百萬元的傳統量販KTV，小型自助店六七十萬元也能起步。成本下去了，壓價空間也就比傳統模式要高出一截。
因為主要靠線上獲客，無人自助店沒那麼依賴黃金鋪面帶來客流量，大多開在社區非沿街鋪面或一些租金便宜的商場裡。這樣不僅能省下一筆房租，還能為這些非核心地段帶來人氣。
最後，這種模式更對年輕人胃口。陳先生總結，無人自助模式對消費者的吸引力，一是便宜，且金額完全透明，大學生也負擔得起；二是少了當面交涉壓力，若消費者對服務不滿，可以打電話反映、向平台申訴、申請退款，不必礙於情面勉強消費。
對經營者來說，這也是種解放。陳先生過去開傳統茶樓時，就經常遇到熟客賒賬、拖時長，勸阻怕傷了人情，視而不見又總吃悶虧，改成無人自助後到點斷電，不必內耗、費口舌，讓他省心不少。
paras_en: In an era where people are tightening their wallets and shunning outings, offline entertainment businesses are still racing ahead.

Chinese female university student Marzi shared a personal experience on social media. During the National Day holiday, she and friends walked into a newly opened unmanned self‑service KTV in her hometown county.

During the prime evening hours, almost all similarly sized private rooms at local KTVs were priced at RMB 500 or more, whereas this unmanned KTV’s large private rooms cost about RMB 50 per hour, a price so low it was moving. Customers could buy beer priced at RMB 5‑10 per bottle from a vending machine at the entrance, or bring their own drinks and food.

They had planned to finish at midnight and wanted to extend for two more hours, but found the rooms were already fully booked for the rest of the night. When they left the room, a long queue snaked through the narrow entrance, with some waiting patrons even setting up folding stools to play poker at the door.

She said the booming business of this self‑service KTV was somewhat unexpected yet understandable. After all, the previous wave of unmanned self‑service entertainment—self‑service board‑game rooms—was just as popular, initially hard to book, and in just three years has taken over streets and alleys everywhere.
Behind the endless stream of customers, this unmanned self‑service venture keeps reinventing itself, thriving against market currents.
Financial writer Wu Xiaobo noted that in a sluggish offline consumption climate, the speed at which unmanned self‑service businesses break through is far beyond what people imagined.

The self‑service board‑game brand “Four Friends,” launched in 2022, had opened more than 14,000 venues across China by the end of March this year, quickly becoming one of the 23 brands to join the “10,000‑store club.” In early 2025 it spun off the unmanned self‑service KTV brand “Four Square Friends,” which signed up 1,200 locations within 18 months of its founding.

This is just one example; the market also hosts hundreds of unmanned self‑service chain brands such as Quefa Chao, Ju Hai, Maifan, and many independent stores. Industry estimates put the number of self‑service board‑game rooms in China at over 500,000, thousands of unmanned KTVs, and thousands of unmanned billiard halls, gyms and more.

The first wave of unmanned board‑game rooms has almost completely reshaped China’s board‑game industry in the past three years. A 70‑square‑metre shop can be divided into seven or eight 5‑square‑metre private rooms; customers order via group‑buy platforms and then book through a mini‑program, instantly seeing which rooms are still available. Owners only need to send cleaning staff after a “room cleared” notification, turning idle space into “post‑sleep income.”

Three years later, self‑service KTV has become the new hot spot. In third‑ and fourth‑tier cities and county towns, almost everyone in the entrepreneur community knows it; a founder in a county in Jiangxi even said it was one of the hottest franchise projects last year.
Mr. Chen, who has run unmanned self‑service businesses in Changsha for years, observes that most entrepreneurs of these unmanned KTVs come from self‑service board‑game rooms or traditional KTVs.

He feels the wave deeply. He previously ran a traditional teahouse, converting it into a self‑service board‑game room in 2021. At the end of 2024 he franchised a Quefa Chao self‑service KTV, with the first store quickly opening in the university‑dense Yuelu District of Changsha.

This low‑price singing model, where drinks can be brought in, quickly attracted a crowd. As an early entrant, he recouped his investment in less than a year and promptly opened second and third stores.
In his view, these self‑service leisure venues have several clear advantages over traditional models.

First, they save money. Unmanned self‑service stores don’t need a decorated lobby or storefront, nor a front desk or many staff. The model also allows 24‑hour operation, naturally fitting night‑time activities like card games and karaoke.

For KTV, a traditional large‑scale venue can cost RMB 1‑2 million to set up, whereas a small unmanned shop can start with just RMB 600‑700 thousand. Lower costs give more pricing flexibility than the traditional model.

Because they mainly acquire customers online, unmanned stores aren’t as dependent on premium street‑level foot traffic; many are located in community interiors, non‑street‑front spaces, or cheap malls, saving rent and bringing traffic to non‑core locations.

Finally, the model appeals to young people. Mr. Chen sums up that the attraction lies in two points: it’s cheap and the pricing is completely transparent, affordable for university students; and it removes face‑to‑face negotiation pressure—if customers are dissatisfied they can call, file a platform complaint, or request a refund without feeling obliged to stay.

For operators, it’s also a liberation. When Mr. Chen ran a traditional teahouse, he often faced regulars who bought on credit or overstayed, and he hesitated to enforce rules for fear of hurting relationships, ending up with losses. After switching to unmanned self‑service, the system cuts power at closing time, eliminating internal friction and needless argument, giving him much peace of mind.
